description: This file defines the MainViewModel class for an Android application. It manages app state, communicates with the runtime, handles preferences, and provides observable data via Kotlin flows for UI binding. It also includes numerous functions to control app features like chat, gateway connection, camera, and notifications.

classes.name: MainViewModel
classes.description: An Android ViewModel managing application state, providing observable flows for UI, and functions to interact with app runtime and preferences.

methods.name: attachRuntimeUi
methods.description: Attaches camera and SMS permission management to a UI lifecycle owner.

methods.name: setForeground
methods.description: Sets the app’s foreground state and updates runtime accordingly.

methods.name: setCameraEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables camera feature via preferences.

methods.name: setPreventSleep
methods.description: Prevents device sleep based on preference.

methods.name: setManualEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables manual connection settings.

methods.name: setGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Sets the bootstrap token for gateway.

methods.name: setOnboardingCompleted
methods.description: Marks onboarding as complete and initializes runtime.

methods.name: setCanvasDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables canvas debug status.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingPackagesCsv
methods.description: Updates notification forwarding packages from CSV string.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours
methods.description: Configures quiet hours for notification forwarding.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingMaxEventsPerMinute
methods.description: Sets max notification events per minute.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the session key for notification forwarding.

methods.name: clearPendingAssistantAutoSend
methods.description: Clears pending auto-send message for assistant.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to a specified gateway endpoint.

methods.name: handleCanvasA2UIActionFromWebView
methods.description: Handles UI actions sent from WebView payload.

methods.name: isTrustedCanvasActionUrl
methods.description: Checks if URL is trusted for canvas actions.

methods.name: loadChat
methods.description: Loads a chat session by key.

methods.name: refreshChatSessions
methods.description: Refreshes list of chat sessions with optional limit.

methods.name: sendChatAwaitAcceptance
methods.description: Sends a chat message and awaits acceptance, returning success status.
